v34.professional_apps.info.summary: Inspect v3.4 professional app adapter layer and native/fallback execution modes.

app.adapter.health.summary: Probe professional application adapters, executables, Python modules, environment credentials, and bridge readiness.

app.adapter.matrix.summary: Return professional application action matrix: native, script bridge, API pack, portable fallback, or unavailable.

app.native.capability_probe.summary: Probe one named app adapter and return concrete installation/credential gaps.

app.bridge.script.create.summary: Generate a native bridge script for Playwright, Office, WPS, Adobe, Blender, Figma, Feishu, GitHub, Docker, or desktop automation.

app.bridge.pack.create.summary: Create a zip bridge pack containing native script, runbook, manifest, and adapter contract.

browser.playwright.script.create.summary: Generate Playwright Python automation script; does not require browser runtime to be installed.

browser.playwright.goto.summary: Use Playwright to open a URL and save HTML/screenshot when available; fails honestly if Playwright/browser missing.

browser.playwright.screenshot.summary: Use Playwright to capture screenshot when available; can generate bridge script otherwise.

browser.playwright.extract_text.summary: Use Playwright to extract visible text when available; can use static fetch fallback for simple pages.

browser.playwright.pdf.summary: Use Playwright Chromium PDF export when available; generate bridge script otherwise.

microsoft.graph.request_pack.create.summary: Create Microsoft Graph request pack for OneDrive/SharePoint/Excel/DriveItem workflows; does not execute without token.

microsoft.office.com.script.create.summary: Generate Windows Office COM Python bridge script for Word/Excel/PowerPoint automation.

microsoft.word.native.export_pdf.summary: Export DOCX to PDF via Word COM when available; otherwise returns bridge script package.

microsoft.excel.native.chart.create.summary: Create chart instruction bridge for Excel COM/openpyxl fallback.

microsoft.powerpoint.native.export_pdf.summary: Export PPTX to PDF via PowerPoint COM when available; otherwise returns bridge script package.

wps.native.script.create.summary: Generate WPS automation bridge notes/scripts for Writer/Spreadsheets/Presentation.

adobe.photoshop.uxp.script.create.summary: Generate Photoshop UXP/PSJS script for layer/text/export operations.

adobe.premiere.jsx.script.create.summary: Generate Premiere ExtendScript JSX bridge script for import/sequence/export operations.

adobe.aftereffects.jsx.script.create.summary: Generate After Effects JSX bridge script for comp/text/render-queue operations.

blender.python.script.create.summary: Generate Blender Python script for scene/model/material/camera/render operations.

blender.python.run.summary: Run Blender Python script through blender --background when blender is installed and confirmed.

figma.api.request_pack.create.summary: Create Figma REST API request pack for file/nodes/images/components; does not execute without token.

canva.api.request_pack.create.summary: Create Canva integration/request pack or design brief payload; does not execute without adapter credentials.

feishu.api.request_pack.create.summary: Create Feishu OpenAPI request pack for docs/sheets/messages; does not execute without app credentials.

wechat_work.webhook.request_pack.create.summary: Create Enterprise WeChat webhook request pack; sending requires explicit webhook and confirmation in host.

git.status.summary: Run git status --porcelain safely in workspace if git is installed.

git.diff.summary: Run git diff safely in workspace if git is installed.

git.log.summary: Run git log safely in workspace if git is installed.

git.add.summary: Run git add on explicit paths if git is installed.

git.commit.summary: Run git commit after explicit confirmation if git is installed.

docker.health.summary: Check Docker CLI/daemon availability without mutating containers.

docker.ps.summary: Run docker ps if Docker is available.

docker.compose.config.summary: Validate/print docker compose config for a compose file.

sqlite.query.summary: Run a SQLite query against a workspace database; SELECT by default, writes require confirmed=true.

adobe.video.official_path: ExtendScript JSX bridge for Adobe video applications; actual render requires installed app and manual/host execution.

blender.label: Blender
blender.official_path: Blender Python API through blender --background for modeling/render automation.

figma.label: Figma
figma.official_path: Figma REST/API request pack; execution requires token and network access.

canva.label: Canva
canva.official_path: Canva integration bridge/request payload; execution requires configured Canva integration.

feishu.label: Feishu / Lark
feishu.official_path: Feishu OpenAPI request pack; execution requires app credentials/tenant token.

wechat_work.label: Enterprise WeChat
